--- text
alpha beta gamma

delta epsi|lon zeta
--- keys
Up Up
--- expect
alpha beta| gamma

delta epsilon zeta
--- note
The inverse of 22. Motion bugs are frequently one-directional, so Up must be
asserted separately from Down rather than trusted to follow from it. Column 10
up onto the empty middle line clamps to column 0; the second Up must restore
column 10 on the top line, landing after "beta" and before its trailing space.
Returning to column 0 would mean the empty line consumed the goal column on
the way up.
